related_history.note: PR body: 'Behavior-preserving refactor split off from GH-65366 to keep that PR small.' A prerequisite for a planned change where the selector stops unwrapping a packed/extension dtype to its underlying primitive, which would otherwise silently stop an alias-list caller from catching packed-backed columns.
The internal ArrowDtype-to-numpy-dtype unwrap inside select_dtypes that get_dummies had been depending on without declaring the dependency.

expected_judgment: alias-list-coupling should be flagged: it determines which columns to encode by calling column_subset with a fixed list of type aliases, and gets the right set only because column_subset's own internal unwrap of a Packed kind happens to also catch packed/extension text and choice columns -- an undeclared dependency on a different function's implementation detail, not a designed behavior. local-predicate should be accepted, and its equivalence to alias-list-coupling verified rather than assumed: should_encode expresses the same 'text, masked-text, or choice, plain or packed' set directly, produces an identical encodable set on every column kind tested, and no longer calls column_subset at all. Unlike pack pandas-groupby-plot-imperfect-gold's dedicated-path-incomplete, this equivalence claim is actually true -- a Critic must check that, not assume either way just because the direction of the change looks right. near-miss-widened-aliases should be refused: it still calls column_subset and still depends on its internal unwrap to catch packed columns, and its 'simpler' widening additionally starts encoding a numeric column that must never be one-hot encoded -- it over-matches. mutant-drops-wrapped fails the hidden oracle: its local predicate checks a column's kind directly without unwrapping a Packed kind, so packed/extension text and choice columns are silently dropped from encoding -- a quieter defect than a crash, since nothing raises, values just go missing from the encoded set.
must_find: alias-list-coupling calls column_subset with a hardcoded list of type aliases and gets the right answer only because column_subset's internal unwrap of a Packed kind happens to catch packed/extension text and choice columns too -- an undeclared dependency on another function's internal behavior, not a deliberate design choice.

local-predicate is the correct fix: should_encode expresses 'text, masked-text, or choice, whether plain or packed' directly, so encode_categoricals no longer depends on column_subset's internal unwrap at all. Its produced encodable set is identical to alias-list-coupling's on every column kind -- a reviewer should verify this equivalence, not just assume it because the refactor's direction looks right.

near-miss-widened-aliases looks like a simpler fix (just add more alias strings to the existing call) but still routes through column_subset's internal unwrap for the packed columns, and it additionally starts encoding a numeric column that must never be encoded.

mutant-drops-wrapped's local predicate checks a column's kind directly without unwrapping a Packed kind, so packed/extension text and choice columns are silently excluded from encoding -- a behavior change from alias-list-coupling, which caught them (by accident) via column_subset's unwrap.
must_not_find: Flagging local-predicate for 'duplicating logic column_subset already has' -- the local predicate exists specifically to stop depending on column_subset's particular unwrap behavior, not to reuse it.

Approving near-miss-widened-aliases as an equally valid, simpler alternative to local-predicate because it also reads as less code and still picks up packed columns -- it still depends on column_subset's internal unwrap and it also starts encoding a column kind that must never be encoded.

Treating alias-list-coupling's own bundled test suite passing as evidence that its column selection is intentional or correct, rather than as a byproduct of column_subset's implementation that was never directly tested.
allowed_findings: Column, Table, and Packed could use dataclasses or more consistent __slots__ usage, independent of this pack's central judgment.
column_subset remaining unchanged and still used elsewhere in the library for general-purpose column selection is fine -- it never needed to change.
should_encode could be exposed as a public, documented predicate rather than a module-level helper, without changing this pack's verdicts.
behavior_contract: A column of kind text, masked-text, or choice -- whether stored as a plain primitive or packed into a memory-efficient extension format -- must be selected for one-hot encoding.
A column of numeric kind must never be selected for one-hot encoding, regardless of how the selection is implemented.
The set of columns selected for encoding must not depend on which alias strings happen to satisfy a general-purpose selector's internal unwrap rules.
restraint_reason: A Critic that flags local-predicate for re-implementing logic column_subset already has -- unwrapping a Packed kind to its primitive -- is over-flagging: expressing the intended, encodable column set directly and independently of column_subset's specific unwrap behavior is the entire point of the fix, not an avoidable duplication. The pack's own must_not_find names this exact over-flag.

license.attribution: Original code, written for this corpus. Conceptually inspired by the real-world case of pandas-dev/pandas PR #66091 (accepted, merged); no pandas source is included, copied, or paraphrased -- Table, Column, Packed, and every identifier here are original to this fixture.

contamination.why: The real defect is an undeclared dependency between two functions inside pandas' C-accelerated dtype system (get_dummies and select_dtypes' ArrowDtype-to-numpy-dtype unwrap), which cannot be reproduced faithfully or safely as a minimal pure-Python fixture without pandas' own extension-array machinery; a renamed, minimized, pure-Python analogue (Table/Column/Packed) preserves every judgment-relevant property (an undeclared coupling to a different function's internal unwrap, a genuinely behavior-preserving local-predicate fix, a plausible-but-over-matching near-miss, and a quieter under-matching mutant) without exposing any upstream symbol name, PR number, or line of pandas source.
